headline: Marban Storm Breaks as Callahan's Passage Bears Heaviest Fire
war_summary: The heaviest bombardments of the past two hours fell upon Callahan's Passage, where some twenty-six hundred casualties were counted and eight Warden posts still stand against two Colonial, though no base there has changed hands in six hours. Mooring County, held entire by the Wardens, logged the freshest activity, three events touching its works at the present hour and more than twenty-two hundred casualties in two hours. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest mixed ground: three Warden posts against five Colonial with one vacant, fourteen events in six hours and the latest despatch at the wire. Palantine Berm, which bore the fiercest contest of the previous edition, has quieted to three events in two hours while keeping its seven Warden works. Marban Hollow's storm has likewise broken; two-hour casualties fell to roughly five hundred eighty Colonial and eight hundred ninety Warden, leaving seven Colonial posts and one unclaimed. Nevish Line holds six Warden, one Colonial and one vacant after fifty events in the day, yet nothing in the last two hours. No victor has been declared.
